headline: Peru's Alicorp Buys Flora Food Group's Latin American Spreads Unit for $150M
summary: Peruvian consumer goods company Alicorp closed its acquisition of Flora Food Group's Latin American spreads business for $150.5 million, taking ownership of brands including La Perfecta in Panama.
why: Alicorp is Peru's leading consumer goods and food company, expanding its Latin American market share through targeted cross-border acquisitions.
